description: Computes the Visibility Check from answers to the 16 questions: status for each of the 8 areas (strong, developing, weak, unknown), up to 3 priority gaps with recommendations and up to 2 strengths. Nothing is stored.

answers.description: Map of question id to answer id (evet, kismen, hayir, emin_degil). Get ids from get_visibility_map_questions.

goal.description: Optional goal id (e.g. musteri, ilk, teklif, is, itibar).

lang.description: Response language: tr (Turkish) or en (English). Default tr.

profile.description: Optional profile id (e.g. egitmen, danisman, yonetici, butik).

name: compute_visibility_map
title: Visibility Check: result
